reference_solution:
add:
    add a0, a0, a1
    ret

max2:
    blt a0, a1, use_a1
    ret
use_a1:
    mv a0, a1
    ret

sum_array:
    li t0, 0            # sum
loop:
    beqz a1, done
    lw t1, 0(a0)
    add t0, t0, t1
    addi a0, a0, 4
    addi a1, a1, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

abs_val:
    bgez a0, done
    neg a0, a0
done:
    ret

factorial:
    li t0, 1            # result
    li t1, 1            # i
loop:
    bgt t1, a0, done
    mul t0, t0, t1
    addi t1, t1, 1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

fib:
    addi sp, sp, -16
    sw ra, 12(sp)
    sw s0, 8(sp)
    sw s1, 4(sp)
    li t0, 2
    bge a0, t0, recurse
    # base case: fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1 => a0 already n
    j fib_ret
recurse:
    mv s0, a0
    addi a0, s0, -1
    call fib
    mv s1, a0            # fib(n-1)
    addi a0, s0, -2
    call fib             # fib(n-2)
    add a0, a0, s1
fib_ret:
    lw ra, 12(sp)
    lw s0, 8(sp)
    lw s1, 4(sp)
    addi sp, sp, 16
    ret

reverse_array:
    slli t0, a1, 2       # length in bytes
    add t0, a0, t0
    addi t0, t0, -4      # pointer to last element
    mv t1, a0            # pointer to first
loop:
    bge t1, t0, done
    lw t2, 0(t1)
    lw t3, 0(t0)
    sw t3, 0(t1)
    sw t2, 0(t0)
    addi t1, t1, 4
    addi t0, t0, -4
    j loop
done:
    ret

popcount:
    li t0, 0            # count
loop:
    beqz a0, done
    addi t1, a0, -1
    and a0, a0, t1      # clear lowest set bit
    addi t0, t0, 1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

is_even:
    andi a0, a0, 1
    xori a0, a0, 1
    ret

strlen:
    mv t0, a0
loop:
    lbu t1, 0(t0)
    beqz t1, done
    addi t0, t0, 1
    j loop
done:
    sub a0, t0, a0
    ret

sum_to_n:
    li t0, 0
loop:
    beqz a0, done
    add t0, t0, a0
    addi a0, a0, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

array_max:
    lw t0, 0(a0)         # max = first
    addi a0, a0, 4
    addi a1, a1, -1
loop:
    beqz a1, done
    lw t1, 0(a0)
    ble t1, t0, skip
    mv t0, t1
skip:
    addi a0, a0, 4
    addi a1, a1, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

gcd:
    beqz a1, done
loop:
    remu t0, a0, a1
    mv a0, a1
    mv a1, t0
    bnez a1, loop
done:
    ret

.text
.globl main
main:
    la a0, msg
    li a7, 4
    ecall
    li a7, 10
    ecall
.data
msg: .asciz "RV32\n"

multiply_by_10:
    slli t0, a0, 3       # x * 8
    slli t1, a0, 1       # x * 2
    add a0, t0, t1       # x * 10
    ret

clamp:
    blt a0, a1, use_lo
    bgt a0, a2, use_hi
    ret
use_lo:
    mv a0, a1
    ret
use_hi:
    mv a0, a2
    ret

count_positive:
    li t0, 0
loop:
    beqz a1, done
    lw t1, 0(a0)
    blez t1, skip
    addi t0, t0, 1
skip:
    addi a0, a0, 4
    addi a1, a1, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

reverse_bits:
    li t0, 0            # result
    li t1, 32           # counter
loop:
    beqz t1, done
    slli t0, t0, 1
    andi t2, a0, 1
    or t0, t0, t2
    srli a0, a0, 1
    addi t1, t1, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

sum_n:
    li t0, 0
    li t1, 1
loop:
    bgt t1, a0, done
    add t0, t0, t1
    addi t1, t1, 1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

square:
    mul a0, a0, a0
    ret

dot_product:
    li t0, 0             # accumulator
loop:
    beqz a2, done
    lw t1, 0(a0)
    lw t2, 0(a1)
    mul t3, t1, t2
    add t0, t0, t3
    addi a0, a0, 4
    addi a1, a1, 4
    addi a2, a2, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

sign:
    bgtz a0, pos
    bltz a0, neg
    li a0, 0
    ret
pos:
    li a0, 1
    ret
neg:
    li a0, -1
    ret

square_helper:
    mul a0, a0, a0
    ret
sum_of_squares:
    addi sp, sp, -16
    sw ra, 12(sp)
    sw s0, 8(sp)
    sw s1, 4(sp)
    mv s0, a1            # save a1
    call square_helper   # a0 = a0^2
    mv s1, a0            # save first square
    mv a0, s0
    call square_helper   # a0 = a1^2
    add a0, a0, s1
    lw ra, 12(sp)
    lw s0, 8(sp)
    lw s1, 4(sp)
    addi sp, sp, 16
    ret

find_index:
    li t0, 0             # index
loop:
    beq t0, a1, notfound
    lw t1, 0(a0)
    beq t1, a2, done
    addi a0, a0, 4
    addi t0, t0, 1
    j loop
notfound:
    li t0, -1
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

power:
    li t0, 1             # result
    mv t1, a0            # base
loop:
    beqz a1, done
    mul t0, t0, t1
    addi a1, a1, -1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret

popcount:
    li t0, 0
loop:
    beqz a0, done
    andi t1, a0, 1
    add t0, t0, t1
    srli a0, a0, 1
    j loop
done:
    mv a0, t0
    ret
